title: Polish Pork Skewers with Glazed Onions
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish featuring pork skewers with a sweet and sticky glaze made from onions. Perfect for a quick dinner or barbecue.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: cut into uniform pieces for even cooking

ingredients.name: polish sausage, sliced
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds flavor and texture

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: soak in water for at least 30 minutes before use

ingredients.name: garlic powder
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds depth of flavor

instructions: 2. Thread pork, sausage (if using), bell peppers, and onions onto skewers, leaving space between each piece.
3. Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder (if using).
4. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
5. Meanwhile, heat glaze in a small saucepan over medium heat until warm and bubbly.
6. Brush glaze over skewers during last 2 minutes of cooking.
7. Remove skewers from grill and let rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme (if desired).
